name: Goshima Nagi
source:
One of [url=/c6258]Ethan[/url]'s friends. He is extremely serious about studying, and can be easily stressed about his marks. Ethan briefly confides in him, but he forgets after reality is rewritten. He drops out of high school and starts up a dog-walking service in one of the alternate realities.

[from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Time_Hollow]wikipedia[/url]]
